bns:Component.name: Consume_P2P_ErrorQueueEvent
bns:Component.bns:description: Event Streams Consume operation for Sub_ErrorQueue_Consumer (resilience redesign 2026-09-28, mirrors Consume_P2P_ExecutionLog_Event). Topic "edv.transactions.error", subscription "p2p-transactions-error-consumer". Consume (not Listen) because Listen requires an execution worker not enabled on this cloud runtime - see Consume_P2P_ExecutionLog_Event's description and platform_entities/event_streams.md. Needs an external trigger (schedule) rather than reacting to messages instantly - same manual scheduling gap as every other Consume in this framework. acknowledgeLater=true: acked only after the process succeeds; on failure the message returns to the backlog for redelivery (~1-2 min platform-determined interval) - reasonable since the downstream action is an INSERT that Central_Error_Handler only ever produces once per real error, but redelivery on a transient DB failure is still safe (a duplicate error_queue row for the same transaction_id is a manual-retrigger inconvenience, not data corruption). | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57
